name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

Feature requests are welcome as feedback. This project is not accepting
external implementation pull requests at this time.

## Problem

Describe the user or developer problem.

## Proposed Change

Describe the behavior or interface you would like to add or change.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe existing functionality, workarounds, or alternative designs you
considered.

## Compatibility and Validation

Explain compatibility concerns, proposed tests, and any effect on the algorithm,
protobuf API, server, or dataset adapters.

## Additional Context

Add public references or examples that may help evaluate the request.
